title: Cohort rollup blocking checkout during audit window

brief.headline: Continuity Guardian could not reach its model to produce a grounded review
brief.what_broke: 12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 1276932 (batch_worker/analytics_cohort_rollup, idle in transaction, txn open 4.2s) blocks 1 session(s); last statement: SELECT 1
brief.who_is_affected: Checkout success 0% over 30s (120/120 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $18,400/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

options.description: Terminate the root blocker session (batch_worker/analytics_cohort_rollup, pid 1276932) to release its locks.
Take no action; let the blocker finish and monitor checkout recovery.
options.cost: about $18,400/min of checkout revenue at risk while waiting

brief.recommendation: Root blocker pid 1276932 (analytics_cohort_rollup) is idle in transaction for 4.2s with last statement SELECT 1, indicating it is not actively working but holds locks blocking checkout [DB-1]. Checkout success is 55-77% vs 95% SLO with $4,293/min revenue at risk [TEL-1, BIZ-1]. Business tolerates at most 60s degraded checkout [BIZ-1]. Memory shows terminating similar batch_replayable_* workloads restored checkout to 100% [MEM-1]. However, workload registry and tradeoff data are missing to confirm replayability and interrupt cost for this specific workload.

data.story: The analytics cohort rollup is holding a lock on order rows and checkout is failing. The job is normally safe to kill, but there is an active change entry for the year-end audit.
